info.title: Read what is written
info.text:
Follow the code, not the intended outcome.

Record changing values in order.

Predict outputs before changing anything.

Challenge: What is printed and why?

14. y becomes 7, then x is assigned 7 * 2.

info.title: Correct an operation
info.text:
Compare the calculation with the requirement.

Check using a small known example.

Change the faulty operation only.

Challenge: What are the wrong and correct results?

The wrong result is 8. The correct total is 15.

info.title: Correct a boundary
info.text:
Translate inclusive wording carefully.

Check the value exactly at the threshold.

A running program can still reject valid input.

Challenge: Which test exposes the error?

40, because it should pass but the faulty condition rejects it.

info.title: Complete an update
info.text:
A loop must move towards its end condition.

Choose an update consistent with the start.

Trace at least two iterations.

Challenge: Complete the update so it prints 3, 2, 1.

n = n - 1.

info.title: Refine an omitted case
info.text:
Check whether every valid situation is handled.

Equal values often need their own case.

Refine the output rather than hiding the case.

Challenge: What happens incorrectly when a == b?

The ELSE branch declares B the winner even though the values are equal.

info.title: Recheck the correction
info.text:
Retest the original failing input.

Check an input that previously worked.

One successful test is not proof of correctness.

Challenge: Why rerun a previously successful case?

The correction might accidentally break behaviour that was already correct.
